operating_question: Run incident command, EOCs, common operating pictures, and resource requests as service-floor machinery, not theatre
Convert rapid damage, impact, and needs assessments into routed recovery actions before declarations become the only proof
Publish lifeline stabilization clocks and restoration exceptions before aggregate recovery claims hide service-floor failure
Treat post-disaster building safety, habitability placards, utility reconnection, and safe return as recovery gates, not paperwork
Make survivor intake, field navigation, 211/311-style help, case status, and grievances a service floor after shocks
Operate commodities, points of distribution, route-to-need logistics, and demobilization as service floors, not piles of supplies
Route volunteers, donations, mutual aid offers, and community capacity before goodwill clogs the response system
Constrain emergency powers, movement limits, quarantine, commandeering, and access controls with rights, sunsets, and appeal paths
